name: Fiona O'Reilly
source:
Fiona is the current proprietor of the O'Reilly's Bar, having taken over after her father died. Her mother Riona and her younger twin sisters Ella & Ellie also work at the bar, albeit mostly in the kitchen.  Fiona mentions that she also has four brothers (as an explanation of her brawling skills). Given that they are never seen and don't appear to live at home, they are probably older.

She takes an immediate liking to the Main Character and flirts openly with him. Fiona is kind of an odd woman: at one moment she is every bit the hot and eager girlfriend, and the next she just as happily acts as a wingman (well, wing-[i]woman[/i]) to the protagonist, setting him up with others (especially her mom). She even admits to fantasizing about the protagonist with other women!

She is the first to spot that Liz has repressed sexual feelings for the protagonist and proves it to him by making out with him in front of her (as she is "just" his aunt) and halfway-whispers "now, look at her face and tell me if she doesn't look like a jealous girlfriend?" Which, of course, Liz does.
